scope: M1 held-in development recordings; simulated chronological transfer, not official held-out EvalAI results
setup: Set FALCON_DATA to DANDI 000941 with held-in-calib and held-in-minival subdirectories. Install requirements plus falcon-challenge; scripts/requirements-local.txt records the verified local core versions.
reporting: Days have equal weight within each seed; reported SD is sample SD across seed means. Calibration and validation scores use different selection procedures and scoring intervals.
provenance: Completed runs copied from runs/. Validation config was reconstructed from the supplied command; per-seed records are unchanged. Historical single-seed baseline was recovered from terminal output and is labeled separately.
